PAHT-CF_bambu.note: No published hole/outer default exists for this filament on this printer, and nothing is borrowed from PLA, PETG or ABS to look complete. Zero deltas mean NO compensation until lril3d-calibrate prints and measures a hole gauge and a pin gauge in this material; every compensated export warns until then. Added 2026-10-07 for seanrobertwright/fpv #5.
